lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots are arranged in semi-regular horizontal chains across the lateral flank, with a primary concentration appearing posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot clusters, creating a grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral body surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge extends horizontally above the branchial region, marked by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five yellow pilot fish (Gnathanodon speciosus) and one remora (Echeneidae) are visible in the water column adjacent to the shark's ventral and pectoral regions.
